name: AI Image to Frame Animation to 3D
philosophy: A still image comes to life under the scroll. One crafted visual sequence is the site's centrepiece, with a sense of depth impossible in flat layouts.
principles: One sequence with a clear beginning and end
Provenance of every frame is on record
Depth and parallax come from the image itself
The key frame must be beautiful alone
visualIdentity: A visual narrative: dreamlike or hyper-real imagery with a consistent generated or filmed look.
artDirection: Decide the sequence first: subject, transformation, camera path, then compose the page around it.

layout.composition: A pinned full-viewport frame stage with captions that arrive at set frames, then quiet supporting sections.

typography: Editorial captions timed to frames, with large type only at the key moments.
colour: Taken from the imagery, so the interface feels cut from the same film.
contentPresentation: Captions tied to moments in the sequence, then a short conventional section for details and the call to action.
assets: 24 to 60 frames at most 720 px high and 3 MB in total, with dense keyframes when cut from video. No watermarks: the team found AI and stock marks in supplied assets.
animation: Canvas-drawn scrubbed frames, depth-map parallax on pointer.
scrolling: Pinned while the sequence plays; scroll position maps directly to the frame.
responsive: A smaller frame set or the static key frame on mobile and low-end devices.

compatibleWith.when: The sequence is the central scene of a longer scroll story

fromTeam: Workbook: frame scrub proven, depth-map untried, lag from sparse keyframes, watermarks in assets
Skill: FrameSequence and DepthParallax with provenance
